structuralDecisions.decision: Add fetchExpeditions() in a new sibling module, apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/api/expeditions.ts — not inside ReagentMapView.vue and not appended to an existing client file.
structuralDecisions.rationale: Matches the established one-file-per-resource client pattern (reagentSites.ts, orders.ts, items.ts), each resolving API_BASE at runtime independently. Keeps fetch/timeout/header concerns out of the view, consistent with every other resource.
tradeOffs: Duplicates the runtime API_BASE/isLocal resolution block a fourth time (reagentSites.ts, orders.ts, items.ts, now expeditions.ts) — accepted because this order is additive, not a refactor; flagged below as a refactoring opportunity.

fitness.property: No fetch()/HTTP call exists outside apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/api/*.ts
fitness.verification: judgment-only — no eslint-plugin-boundaries config is wired for apps/ye-olde-magic-shop yet, though ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md section IV.2 names it as the intended mechanism; code-reviewer checks by grepping for fetch( outside src/api/ until that config exists.

structuralDecisions.decision: fetchExpeditions() attaches Authorization only when a token is present in localStorage('dnd_auth_token'), and omits Content-Type entirely (this is a bodyless GET) — a trimmed inline copy of orders.ts's getAuthHeaders(), not a shared helper.
structuralDecisions.rationale: GET /api/expeditions already tolerates an absent or invalid token per the NFR; sending Content-Type on a bodyless GET would be new, uncalled-for behavior no other client in this app exhibits.
tradeOffs: Introduces a second, slightly different header-building block instead of extracting a shared getAuthHeaders(token?, hasBody?) helper — accepted because that extraction is a cross-cutting refactor outside this order's additive scope; flagged below.

structuralDecisions.decision: Draw expeditions via a new addExpeditionEntities() helper, same shape and call site (onMounted, right after addSiteEntities) as the existing site-marker helper — no new base class, no typed entity wrapper.
structuralDecisions.rationale: Mirrors addSiteEntities() exactly: same parameter order (Cesium, viewer, ellipsoid, data[]), same ad-hoc `(entity as unknown as {...}).saturdayMetadata =` tagging cast already present in the file. Introducing a typed Entity-tagging wrapper now would be new pattern for a second call site, not justified by this order alone.
tradeOffs: The unknown-cast for saturdayMetadata is now duplicated across two helpers instead of extracted into one tagging utility — accepted, same reasoning as above.

structuralDecisions.decision: Site-list items become <button type="button"> controls calling flyToSite(site); the Cesium module and ellipsoid returned by buildViewer() are promoted to component-scope variables (same lifetime as the existing `viewer` variable) so flyToSite can reach them. No composable, no Pinia store.
structuralDecisions.rationale: flyToSite is behavior local to this one view's own Cesium viewer instance; there is exactly one consumer. A composable or store would be premature generalization — nothing else in the app needs camera control.
tradeOffs: ReagentMapView.vue's component-scope state grows from one variable (viewer) to three (viewer, Cesium module, ellipsoid) — accepted; still one <script setup> module, no new file, no new public surface.

componentPlacement.reason: Converts the mock API's JSON response into the app's Expedition/GeoPoint shape — same role and layer as the existing fetchReagentSites() and fetchOrders().
Cesium entity construction is adapter-layer glue between fetched data and the Viewer, the same role the existing addSiteEntities() already plays in this file.
Camera control is Viewer glue, not domain logic; stays beside buildViewer()/addSiteEntities() in the view rather than a new composable.

boundedContext.owning: Expedition Planning (Ye Olde Magic Shop demo app) — DOMAIN_DICTIONARY.md section 7
crossings: apps/mock-api GET /api/expeditions — consumed only; already shipped, no backend change in this order

stabilityDesign.rationale: Mirrors fetchReagentSites()'s existing timeout, satisfying architecture-guardrails.md #5's explicit-timeout requirement. No retry loop is introduced anywhere — a rejected promise is handled by onMounted's existing Promise.allSettled failure path, not a custom retry/sleep loop.

layerBoundaryChecks.rule: Domain/UseCases layers must not import Adapters or Frameworks (ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md section I)
layerBoundaryChecks.notes: This Vue demo app has no separate domain/use-case layer to protect — ReagentMapView.vue and api/*.ts are both adapter-level (UI + HTTP client). Confirmed by reading both files directly; no graph query was available/needed for a two-file app slice.

layerBoundaryChecks.rule: New apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/api/*.ts module has exactly one consumer (the view that needs it)
layerBoundaryChecks.notes: Read reagentSites.ts and orders.ts: each is a single-purpose client imported by exactly one view/store. expeditions.ts is expected to follow the same shape, imported only by ReagentMapView.vue.

antiPatternChecks.notes: No new abstraction, composable, or store introduced; addExpeditionEntities() and flyToSite() copy the exact shape of the existing buildViewer()/addSiteEntities() functions rather than generalizing early.
Additive only — one new file (expeditions.ts) plus one view file touched; reagentSites.ts, orders.ts, items.ts untouched.
No new interface is exposed for other callers to depend on; expeditions.ts exports only fetchExpeditions() and its two plain data types, same surface shape as reagentSites.ts.

ReagentMapView.vue grows by two helper functions, one ref, and three component-scope variables; it remains single-responsibility (render the Aurelis map and its controls), not accumulating unrelated concerns.

fitnessFunctions.property: Every new or changed function in this order keeps cyclomatic complexity below 7
fitnessFunctions.verification: ESLint complexity rule capped at 6 (typescript-conventions.md / ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md section 140), run in CI lint

fitnessFunctions.property: No fetch()/HTTP call exists outside apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/api/*.ts
fitnessFunctions.verification: judgment-only until eslint-plugin-boundaries is wired for this app; code-reviewer greps for fetch( outside src/api/

fitnessFunctions.property: No request from /reagent-map leaves the app's or mock API's own origin
fitnessFunctions.verification: apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts's existing off-origin NFR test continues to pass once fetchExpeditions() uses the same runtime API_BASE resolution as fetchReagentSites()

refactoringOpportunities.target: The runtime API_BASE/isLocal resolution block, now duplicated across reagentSites.ts, orders.ts, items.ts, and expeditions.ts
refactoringOpportunities.reason: Four independent copies of the same 5-line block violate 'no duplication' (design-principles.md #1.3); a shared apiBase.ts would remove it. Out of scope for this additive order — flag for a future chore.

refactoringOpportunities.target: The optional-Authorization-header logic duplicated between orders.ts's getAuthHeaders() and expeditions.ts's trimmed inline equivalent
refactoringOpportunities.reason: A third API client needing an optional-Authorization pattern would make this duplication worth a shared getAuthHeaders(token?, hasBody?) helper; not required yet at two call sites.

developerHandoffNotes: No new package, base class, or layer boundary is introduced by this order — follow the analyst's developerTasks list exactly; this architecture pass only confirms placement and names two deferred refactoring opportunities (API_BASE duplication, auth-header duplication) that are explicitly out of scope.
expeditions.ts exports GeoPoint and Expedition types plus fetchExpeditions() only — keep the same minimal export surface as reagentSites.ts.
Do not extract a shared apiBase.ts or getAuthHeaders() helper as part of this order even though the duplication is visible — that is a separate refactor, not this feature's scope.
Keep the exact mapError text 'Failed to load reagent sites. Try refreshing the page.' on either sites or expeditions fetch failure — rewording breaks reagent-map-error.png's baseline.
openQuestions: Analyst's architecturalFlags already noted this order is additive enough that the architect stage was skippable (CLAUDE.md's 'Skip architect for purely additive features' clause); this pass concurs in hindsight — no blocking structural question was found. Noting it only so the pipeline can tune the architect-invocation heuristic for similar future orders.
